verdict.rationale: Wave is small-business accounting and invoicing SaaS, so operating it through natural-language commands is a fair axis for this kind of product. However, nothing in the evidence pack documents a natural-language, chat, or AI-assistant interface. The features shown are automation (auto-categorization, recurring invoices, reminders) and OCR receipt scanning, which are adjacent features and earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands
